lessons.title: disaggregated_encoder e2e: decode engine crashes with batch_norm eps=0.0 (upstream FusedInputNorm x torch 2.11)
lessons.symptom: test_disaggregated_encoder[1-Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct]: the ENCODE server becomes healthy, but the DECODE (EC consumer) server never does. Its EngineCore dies in profile_run with "ValueError: batch_norm eps must be positive, but got 0.0" (vision.py F.batch_norm), right after "Encoder cache will be initialized with a budget of 16384 tokens, and profiled with 1 video items". The test then spins its health-wait loop (READY spam) until the suite timeout SIGKILLs it (exit -9). Same crash on the a3-2 PR CI matrix and on vllm main 073c510c/0820125ae.
lessons.root_cause: vllm main PR #50411 ("Fused mm preprocess normalisation on the Device", merged 2026-08-06) rewrote Qwen2_5_VLInputNorm.forward to call F.batch_norm with HARDCODED eps=0.0 (vllm/model_executor/models/vision.py:727). torch 2.11 rejects eps<=0 unconditionally (torch/nn/functional.py:2844); torch 2.12+ only checks during training, so upstream vllm CI (torch 2.12+) passes while vllm-ascend containers (torch 2.11) crash deterministically. Still present at vllm main HEAD as of 2026-08-10.
fix_guidance: vllm-ascend workaround: add a patch/platform entry (precedent: patch_fused_moe, patch_mla_prefill_backend) that wraps Qwen2_5_VLInputNorm.forward and passes eps=1e-5 instead of 0.0 (eval mode, eps is cosmetic — the normalization result is identical).
OR bump the CI container torch to 2.12+, where batch_norm(eps=0) is allowed outside training (upstream fix path).
Do NOT treat this as an env flake: it recurs on every run/matrix (vllm main + torch 2.11).
The test also requires the vllm-ascend/mm_request modelscope dataset + Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct cached on the runner; without them it fails earlier at collection/model load.
Note: the flow now inlines error-signature excerpts (not just the log tail) so this traceback reaches the adapter even after the 30-min READY spam.
lessons.example: run 31322838012 rerun: decode engine crashed at profile_run with the eps error, but the old error_logs tail-cut only showed READY spam, so the adapter could not see the cause. Fixed by error-excerpt extraction in main2main_flow.
